baselineRegression.method: Nineteen targeted final component tests against isolated turn-start copies of LegalHub, LegalCaseSearch, LegalAssetTrace and useLegalDocument. Other 64 cases excluded from this baseline-only run. These are parameterized failures, not nineteen independent defects.

diffCheck: passed with repository CRLF whitespace settings
changes: LegalCaseSearch and LegalAssetTrace reuse the existing keyed request hook: one lock, abort ownership, result/error lifecycle, and preservation of drafts on metadata/language changes. Removed their separate loading/result/reset-effect flows.
Search selection is an index into current derived results instead of another stored result object. Removed unreachable empty-result state, unused trace UI translation props and unused risks field.
Asset and equity requests remain sequential, share one argument object and stop the remaining chain after cancellation or failure.

Existing hook now owns manual archive locking and confirmation. Six manual archive entries await boolean persistence; false/throw preserves generated output for retry, and stale success notifications are suppressed. Four redundant archive wrapper functions were removed.
Asset errors are no longer marked ready or offered for archive. Judgment import awaits case material persistence before showing an overall successful result.
Existing failed-import component assertion now requires an error/nonready state after a failed archive; added ownership, rapid-action, failure/retry and import confirmation cases.
preserved: Original tool names, search/trace argument fields, case/organization scoping, ordered asset-then-equity execution and organization automatic-archive behavior.
Citation and selected-search-result manual material writes remain separate because those tools do not automatically archive selected case material.
Original case-search and asset response parsers, structured views, titles, archive content and manual archive availability.
No new business module or test file, user data untouched.
limitations: Frontend cancellation does not undo backend writes. A case archive started before navigation can still finish against the original case; its late UI completion is suppressed.
Knowledge import and case material persistence are separate operations: an archive failure may follow an already-successful knowledge import. No atomic transaction or rollback is claimed.
Mocked component HTTP and isolated backend regressions only; no real model call, native-client/visual acceptance or full-suite rerun.
Earlier write queue is still per mounted hub without keystroke coalescing. Legacy personal storage account isolation, multi-entry local model persistence and remaining program zones remain open.
No commit, push, backend rebuild or client restart.
